rules: Current face-space-normalization-research-v0 name is a research namespace, not calibrated normalization authority.
No center, scale, percentile, enum boundary, or production threshold may be invented from the current single-fixture evidence.
Same-provider normalization readiness is independent from cross-provider anchor equivalence.
Cross-provider normalization must additionally respect providerAnchorEquivalence from the semantic contract.
Controlled 3D same-identity stress is diagnostic operator evidence only; Face Space photo normalization readiness requires real-photo same-subject pose and expression evidence.
A provisional normalization candidate remains research-only and must not activate Archetype, Face Space production, or style recommendation.
No identity embedding or biometric identity matching may be used to establish same-subject linkage; linkage must come from dataset provenance or manual research metadata.
